question: Related Questions Q. Assalam alai Kum Bhai Saab, i am passing thru a very bad phase. My sister & her son-in-laws practice black magic on my parents, my husband, me and my kids for property. the result is my husband who use to love us so much left us and is staying with her. My parents have gone against me over petty issues which are between my and my husband and support him. My kids and i are in a fix what to do. Past 5-8 yrs we have no physical relationship as he was stationed in riyadh and had a extra-marital affair there. Now he wants to re-marry as he brought the girl to our hometown , he wants me to sell my house which i purchased on my own money and give him 50% share so that he starts new business and settles with his young lady as he is 60 Yrs now. He refuses to give me Talaq or Khula. Pls advise what shd i do in this case. My grown up children are not agreeing to their father. 1941 views Q. Mufti saab please help me. My financial condition is bad. I'm looking for job but I can't find it. My fate is really not helping me at all. Anything I do turns against me. Nothing is working for me. It's like my fate has it's doors closed nothing works for me. Can you please tell me what to do? Can you recommended me a Duva that can help me. Thank You 2371 views Q. Assalaamu alaikum wa rahmatullah, Dear Sheikh, I pray to Allah SWT that you are enjoying a good health & high Islamic spirit. (1) It has come to my knowledge that some people observe certain nawwafil salaah by reciting any specific surah a certain number of times( that is more than once) in each raka'ah after reading surah faati'ha. Sometimes they would make an extra sajdah after reading the tashahhud & darood and there, they would ask for any specific doah they are in need for. They would even call this salah as haajaat. However I have not cross of any of this kind of salaah in the ahadeeth. Could you please enlighten me on this. (2) My second question is about those 'aamil who after asking someone's name & mother's name, claim that they make istikhaarah salah in order to find out if that person is under the influence of jiin or evil eyes etc. As far as i understand, Istikhaarah salaah is accomplished when someone is unsure of whether doing something is good for him/her or not. But what I don't understand is how Istikhaarah salaah can help someone to find out the malady of someone else. Would that not be more appropriate to offer haajah salaah in this context? I look forward to your valuable views and comments on the above two issues Incha Allah. I thank you in anticipation for your cooperation. Wassalaam. 2469 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 65425 Country: India Title: Dua or Wazifa for good family relations Question: We are a family of 12 people. Father, mother and 7 children. First 2 children (I'm the 2nd son) are married. All of us stay in the same house. I feel there is a lot of misunderstanding and miscommunication amongst all of our family members. This leads to strained relations. Please tell me a dua or wazifahs that I can perform for happiness, love, unity, good relations and co-operation in the family. Answer ID: 65425 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 799/787/H=08/1437) After every salah and before going to bed, recite the following dua three times with durood before and after 3-3 times and supplicate Allah. رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَاجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّاتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَاجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَاماً . Also start reading Fazail Amal and Bahishti Zewar at your home. May Allah bless you with every virtue and save you from every evil! Amen! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
